projects.title: ConstructionPro — Professionals Nepal
projects.summary: A marketplace where families in Nepal find house designs with cost estimates and book the architects, engineers and contractors who drew them.
projects.description: ConstructionPro connects people who want to build a house with the professionals who design them. Clients browse a design library with filters for budget, area and style, save favourites, book a consultation in a professional's free time slot, and chat in real time. Professionals manage their portfolio, availability and bookings from a dashboard, and admins moderate content and export reports.
features: Design library with search, filters, sorting and shareable URLs
Booking system built on each professional's published availability
Real-time messaging with online status and typing indicators (Socket.IO)
Role-based dashboards for clients, professionals and admins, with charts and CSV export
JWT authentication, image uploads, light and dark themes

projects.title: MCQPrep — Exam Practice App
projects.summary: MCQ practice for Nepal's entrance and competitive exams (IOE, IOM, KU, Loksewa) with instant feedback and an admin question bank.
projects.description: Students pick a course and subject and get questions they haven't seen yet, with the correct answer and an explanation shown as soon as they answer. Progress and accuracy are tracked per subject without needing an account. Admins log in to manage courses, subjects and the question bank through a fast editor.
features: No-repeat questions drawn from the ones a student hasn't answered yet
Answers are checked on the server — the answer key never reaches the browser early
Progress bars, accuracy, session score and streaks
Keyboard shortcuts for answering and moving to the next question
Admin dashboard, question bank search and a bulk-friendly question editor

projects.title: Heart Attack Prediction
projects.summary: A machine learning model that predicts heart attack risk from clinical data, with tuning and a full evaluation.
projects.description: An end-to-end ML project on a clinical heart-disease dataset: exploring and visualising the data, cleaning and one-hot encoding features, training a decision tree classifier, and tuning its hyperparameters with cross-validated grid search before evaluating it on held-out data.
features: Exploratory analysis: distributions, correlations, age vs cholesterol, blood pressure by outcome
Decision tree classifier tuned with GridSearchCV over 10 runs
Evaluation with confusion matrix and classification report

projects.title: Zomato Restaurant Data Analysis
projects.summary: Exploratory data analysis of 9,500+ Zomato restaurants: ratings, countries, cities and online delivery.
projects.description: Merged the Zomato restaurant dataset with country codes and explored it with pandas and Seaborn: checking missing values, grouping ratings into bands, comparing countries and cities, and finding where online delivery is available.
features: Most records come from India, followed by the USA and the UK
Most ratings fall between 2.5 and 3.9, with a large share of unrated restaurants
Unrated restaurants are almost all in India
Online delivery is only offered in India and the UAE
